title: FlapLab Daily — No Flights, No Tights
story: You are Clark Kent. Ten seasons of 'no flights, no tights' — and on Smallville's 25th birthday you finally get airborne over the Kent farm. Shame about the meteor rocks.
inspiration: Smallville turned 25 (premiered 16 Oct 2001): X Trending 'Smallville Marks 25 Years with Fan Nostalgia and Suit Debates' (x.com/i/trending/2111074172814413839, 17–18 Oct 2026) — fans roasting the 'no flights, no tights' rule and the decade-long wait for the suit. Tom Welling-era Clark promo still + green crystal cluster as kryptonite (both from PNG sites with baked checkerboard, cleaned with rembg + saturation key), red barn in cornfield (Wikimedia) as the Kent farm.
